name: Authored comparison integration holdout v1
annotation_note: New authored questions fixed before their first measured run. Used to verify the integrated two-facet policy, not to tune thresholds. Independent of prior question files, but not independently human-annotated customer data. Complex qualified comparisons intentionally remain on the full-question path.

questions.question: Compare browser certificate hostname validation with PDF owner permission checks.
Contrast conditional HTTP response caching with a DNS resolver's cached name resolution.
Compare dependency readiness checks with HTTP 429 request limiting.
Compare the maximum pressure of PMP-101 with the maximum pressure of PMP-106.
Compare the inspection interval of PMP-104 with the inspection interval of PMP-88888.
Contrast DNS cache expiry with the ingredients in an apple pie.
